sources.observation: undxf describes a separate no-native-code DXF reader into uncad-model, currently a 0.x spike. It documents ASCII input, Binary DXF through the same text path, handle-based identities, unknown entity name retention, unresolved layer/block names, selected HEADER group values and entity projections, and no DWG or write path. Its ACIS exposure is a wireframe/carrier view, not B-rep reconstruction.

uncad routes DWG through LibreDWG FFI and DXF through undxf. Its real-file tests use LibreDWG's test corpus, with additional hand-authored fixtures and synthetic goldens; the project says its sample directory is git-ignored. The caveats distinguish parser/read diagnostics, model projection and unsupported data, and state that its ACIS route is a wireframe/carrier view rather than full solid semantics.

PyPI lists version 0.3.12 released 2026-10-16 with Trusted Publishing provenance bound to commit e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889. The macOS ARM64 wheel SHA-256 is 94204f623d752e7dacf494bf631551277a985acbeb612ee3a24464ea0f0daab5 and the source archive SHA-256 is eba52992abcf6afce57b0f3526c3afeeed29cc60fbbb61c275958703d597de3a. Project scope remains experimental, profile-limited, and backed by CadQuery/OpenCascade conversion.
